about_desc_body:
Clickra is a premium, ultra-lightweight modern context menu utility designed for Windows 11.
Built with C# NativeAOT, it skips all runtime overhead to deliver sub-10ms instantaneous startup and a zero-dependency user experience that feels like a native OS feature.
about_collab_body:
This project is fully open-source under the Apache 2.0 license! We love community contributions.
Visit our GitHub repository to submit Pull Requests, report issues, or collaborate on building better tools for Windows.
about_diag_body:
Encountered a conversion issue? We've streamlined the feedback process!
Click below to open Gmail Web Composer and highlight 'history.log' in File Explorer. Simply drag the highlighted file into Gmail to send us the diagnostic details.
